protocol.agreement: Require both visual cues at the same frame for this arm. Report each cue independently as well. The cues use shared geometry and motion support; their results are not independent probabilities.
protocol.calibration: Lock the third-largest ordinary development maximum with arm-specific floors. Report isolated and joint signals. Every actual alert on ordinary editing or untouched footage counts against specificity.
protocol.deformation: At mouth-shell and matched reference points, measure the discrepancy between the flow of each point and opposite points a few pixels away. Use the worse of horizontal and vertical normalized bending, conditioned on stable flow and comparable local texture.
protocol.gates: At least four strict LivePortrait hits in three groups, the one strict MuseTalk hit, at least 70% measured each neural family and ordinary controls, at most two ordinary alerts and none on untouched, recompressed, hard-cut, dubbed, silent or cadence-altered controls. Require exact native interval IoU of at least one half.
protocol.ordinary_extra: Use the first planned offset of four previously acquired public speech sources outside GRID/Lombard. Create a common H.264 25 fps delivery and remux unchanged pictures with time-shifted or silent audio. Separately retime lossless pictures with fixed alternating 32 and 48 ms presentation steps.
protocol.scope: Single-upload picture comparison without previous media, sound, text, model/renderer output, or prior region selections. A candidate would contribute zero AI confidence before new independent transfer.
protocol.transport: Estimate forward and return flow from low-pass neighboring native pictures in eye-normalized coordinates. At pixels with verified geometry and a stable round trip, compare the signed fine-detail vectors transported with this flow. Compare mouth skin with skin above and beside it. Fine detail is not used for the flow fit.
protocol.window: Require verified upright native pictures, one shot, frame steps 22–55 ms near that clip’s median, and at least 80% support in each flank and the selected 8, 12, 16 or 20-picture window. Select the greatest positive core difference against both five-frame flanks. Commit before, first, during and first following picture/crop hashes.
